fishbot.gui.title: FishBot Settings
fishbot.chat.rod_switched: §b[FishBot] Switched to a fresh fishing rod.
fishbot.chat.no_rods: §c[FishBot] No usable fishing rod left in the hotbar! Pausing.
fishbot.chat.no_chest: §e[FishBot] Inventory full but no chest/shulker found nearby.
fishbot.openwater.fail: §c[FishBot] Not open water — no treasure loot here!
fishbot.discord.test: FishBot webhook test — notifications are working.
fishbot.opt.enabled.tip: Master switch for the whole bot.
fishbot.opt.detection.tip: PACKET reads synced entity data (100%% reliable). MOTION/SOUND are legacy fallbacks.
fishbot.opt.open_water.tip: Validate the 1.16+ 5x4x5 open-water rule needed for treasure loot.
fishbot.opt.persistent.tip: Keep the hook cast; recast automatically if it disappears.
fishbot.opt.arm_swing.tip: Play the arm swing when using the rod (looks human).
fishbot.opt.reel_min.tip: Minimum randomized delay after a bite before reeling in (humanization).
fishbot.opt.reel_max.tip: Maximum randomized delay after a bite before reeling in (humanization).
fishbot.opt.recast.tip: Delay between landing a catch and casting again.
fishbot.opt.jitter.tip: Randomness added to the recast delay, in percent.
fishbot.opt.multirod.tip: Automatically switch to the next rod in the hotbar when one wears out.
fishbot.opt.rod_threshold.tip: Switch rods when remaining durability drops to this value.
fishbot.opt.break_protection.tip: Stop using a rod before it would break.
fishbot.opt.mending.tip: Move a Mending rod to the off-hand while XP orbs are absorbed to repair it.
fishbot.opt.auto_deposit.tip: Automatically store loot into a nearby chest/shulker when the inventory fills up.
fishbot.opt.deposit_radius.tip: Search radius (blocks) for a chest/shulker box.
fishbot.opt.deposit_trigger.tip: Trigger a deposit when at least this many inventory slots are used.
fishbot.opt.deposit_mode.tip: KEEP_LIST stores everything except kept items. TREASURES stores only treasure items.
fishbot.opt.discard_trash.tip: Throw trash items away instead of storing them.
fishbot.opt.auto_eat.tip: Automatically eat the best food from the hotbar.
fishbot.opt.eat_threshold.tip: Start eating when hunger drops to this value (of 20).
fishbot.opt.deposit_now.tip: Immediately deposit into the nearest chest/shulker.
fishbot.opt.panic.tip: React to damage / low health to protect overnight AFK sessions.
fishbot.opt.panic_health.tip: Panic when health drops below this percentage of max health.
fishbot.opt.panic_damage.tip: Panic whenever any damage is taken (mob, player, lava…).
fishbot.opt.panic_action.tip: What the panic system does when triggered.
fishbot.opt.antiafk.tip: Subtle, irregular micro-movements and key taps to bypass AFK detection.
fishbot.opt.hud_x.tip: Horizontal position of the HUD panel.
fishbot.opt.hud_y.tip: Vertical position of the HUD panel.
fishbot.opt.pause_in_gui.tip: Pause the bot while a container screen is open manually.
fishbot.opt.discord.tip: Send notifications to a Discord webhook.
fishbot.opt.discord_rare.tip: Send a Discord alert when a rare/treasure item is caught.
fishbot.opt.discord_storage.tip: Send a Discord alert when storage is full / a deposit happens.
fishbot.opt.discord_attack.tip: Send a Discord alert when the player is attacked / panics.
fishbot.opt.discord_test.tip: Send a test message to the configured webhook.
fishbot.preset.overnight.tip: Safety-first profile for long unattended sessions.
fishbot.preset.treasure.tip: Open-water checking + deposit only treasure loot.
fishbot.preset.fast.tip: Minimal delays for maximum catches per hour.
fishbot.preset.save.tip: Store the current settings as a preset under the name in the text field.
fishbot.preset.name: Preset name
fishbot.session.save.tip: Store the current stats and settings as a reusable session.
fishbot.session.tip.time: The duration of the saved session.
fishbot.session.tip.fish: Fish caught in the saved session.
fishbot.session.tip.xp: Experience gained in the saved session.
fishbot.session.tip.rare: Rare drops (enchanted book / bow / rod) in the saved session.
